title: Al-Hakim Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: The named mosque enclosure and projecting bases on Al-Muizz Street.

terrainReference.basis: Original ground below the monumental approach off Al-Muizz Street.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap mosque with open courtyard and exact entrance.
mapIdentity.scope: The named native OSM multipolygon places the mosque’s projecting portal, both corner cases, and open courtyard. Museum With No Frontiers documents the 120 by 113 m envelope and 78 by 66 m courtyard, agreeing with the named map geometry.

note: The public-domain Met daguerreotype shows both Mamluk minaret crowns, their different window groups and carved stages. The Egyptian monuments service, Museum With No Frontiers and Archnet identify the projecting portal, arcades, covered prayer hall and surviving central dome. Egyptian government records confirm the 2023 restoration.
